lifeTimeline.summary: Childhood in Greece before moving to Cyprus.
Moved to Cyprus at around 10 years old and grew up there.
Studied physics for 3 years at the University of Cyprus.
Lived and worked on a project in Cameroon for 7 months.
Lived in the United States for around 4 years.
Living and working in Switzerland since 2018.

personalMemoryPlatform.title: Self Memory and Social Platform
personalMemoryPlatform.goal: Upload and organize selective 'consciousness' data (memories, preferences, life history) into a NoSQL backend with voice/text I/O and advanced search.
components: NoSQL Firestore data model for self, memories, relationships, contexts
text-to-voice playback for recall and narration
semantic and contextual search over memories
selective sharing layers for work, dating, friendships, investors
future: purely visual / UI-first social layer with minimal or no raw text
personalMemoryPlatform.notes: This Firestore JSON is intended as the seed representation of personal identity and projects.

hydroPortfolio.title: Swiss Small / Pico-Hydro Portfolio
hydroPortfolio.coreIdea: Develop multiple small hydro installations (≈500 kW class) in Switzerland, ideally using existing infrastructure and distributed water systems, with 0 founder capital and long-term RCC-backed revenues.

revenueStreams: regulated RCC feed-in tariffs for electricity sold to the Swiss grid
optional PPAs with communes or local utilities
optional crypto-mining or energy-backed tokenization layer (Joule)

hydroPortfolio.status: feasibility and investor-pitch-ready; targeting banks, family offices, impact funds, and institutional investors.

documents.title: Plan de Faisabilité Commerciale Intégrée – Installations Hydroélectriques Petite Taille Suisse 500 kW

jouleCrypto.concept: Strictly energy-backed crypto-asset where each token corresponds to a verified unit of energy (e.g., 1 JOULE or 1 kWh) injected into the grid, with no other minting pathway.
designPrinciples: double validation with grid operator readings
tight coupling to real hydro and other renewable portfolios
jouleCrypto.status: conceptual and architecture phase; dependent on hydro portfolio / energy projects.
